key_provisions_or_claims: Sets four values: human dignity and autonomy, respect for Islamic Sharia and Gulf unity, environmental sustainability, peaceful use for well-being.
Sets seven principles: human decision-making, safety, fairness, privacy, transparency, accountability, integrity.
Recommends dataset bias audits, oversight processes and addressing the digital divide.
Encourages national AI ethics committees and ethical impact assessment methodologies.
Member states should reflect it in new legislation, policies and national strategies.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Non-binding GCC guiding manual (v1.0, November 2023) on AI ethics, based on UNESCO's 2021 Recommendation. It sets four values, including respect for Islamic Sharia, and seven principles covering human decision-making, safety, fairness, privacy, transparency, accountability and integrity. It encourages member states to reflect them in legislation and to set up ethics committees.
annotation.title_clean: The Guiding Manual on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence Use in Member States of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC)
